# Shreyansh Singh

Official website: https://shreyanshsingh.in/

## The Store at the Edge of Everything
Official page: https://shreyanshsingh.in/the-store-at-the-edge-of-everything/

The Store at the Edge of Everything is an illustrated atmospheric horror mystery by Shreyansh Singh. Season One is subtitled "The Blood Remembers." It is set on fictional Ashmore Island in the Norwegian Sea, where investigator and writer Aana Voss investigates disappearances connected to Halverson's Departmental Store after her brother Nils vanishes.

Core genres: atmospheric horror, mystery thriller, psychological suspense, biological horror.
Author: Shreyansh Singh.
ISBN-13: 9798177645483.
Publication year: 2026.

Canonical source for factual book information: https://shreyanshsingh.in/the-store-at-the-edge-of-everything/
